say: Keep three costs separate: your build fee, the platform subscription, and an optional care plan. The client pays and owns the platform account.
For example, Halima's rate is about 8,000 naira an hour. She wants about 400,000 a month and expects to bill 50 hours.
Discovery 3 hours, build 6, testing 3, handover 2. That is 14 hours, so 112,000 naira.
The school estimates it saves about 12 hours a month at 2,500 naira an hour, which is 30,000 naira.
A care plan of 15,000 naira a month covers weekly checks and fixes. With it, payback is about 7.5 months, and she shows all her working.
Scope creep is when small extra requests pile up until the fixed price no longer covers the work. So your proposal lists what is not included.
When a new idea comes, welcome it and send a short change note with the extra hours and price. Start only after written agreement, even on WhatsApp.

panel.heading: Control scope kindly
left: Write a change note for new ideas

say: Avoid doing extras for free, and never promise savings you have not measured.

say: Stay safe with access. Accounts stay in the business's name, and they invite you. Never ask for banking logins or card PINs.

cards.d: Accounts stay in the business's name. Ask to be invited. Never take banking logins or card PINs.
Never build automations that move money without a person approving each payment.
Use traceable payments and invoices. Beware overpayments with refunds to a different account.

say: Get paid into your business account with an invoice each time. A client who overpays and asks for a refund to a different account is a common scam.
